title: Findings of the WMT25 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task: Persistent Hurdles in Reasoning, Generation, and Evaluation
authors_zh: Tom Kocmi、Ekaterina Artemova、Eleftherios Avramidis、Eleftheria Briakou、Pinzhen Chen、Marzieh Fadaee、Markus Freitag、Roman Grundkiewicz、Yupeng Hou、Philipp Koehn、Julia Kreutzer、Saab Mansour、Stefano Perrella、Lorenzo Proietti、Parker Riley、Eduardo Sánchez、Patrícia Schmidtová、Mariya Shmatova、Vilém Zouhar
paper_type_zh: 评测、裁判或量表数据论文

one_line: WMT25 MIST releases 30-language reasoning, generation, translation, summarization, and LLM-judge tasks with human evaluation.
WMT25 MIST 跨 30 种语言发布推理、生成、翻译、摘要与 LLM 裁判任务及人类评测。
why: WMT25 MIST releases 30-language reasoning, generation, translation, summarization, and LLM-judge tasks with human evaluation.
inclusion_reason: WMT25 MIST 跨 30 种语言发布推理、生成、翻译、摘要与 LLM 裁判任务及人类评测。

title: Problem
问题
html: Multilingual LLMs are often evaluated only on translated English benchmarks, with inconsistent tasks, languages, and evaluation pipelines, making it difficult to determine whether they truly support cross-lingual reasoning, generation, and evaluation. Machine-translation scores do not represent open-ended writing, cross-lingual summarization, or linguistic reasoning. WMT25 MIST therefore asks how to establish a shared task spanning multiple capabilities and 30 languages under a unified submission protocol, and how human annotations can test the reliability of automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-judge systems in multilingual settings.
多语言 LLM 往往只在翻译后的英语 benchmark 上报告结果，任务、语言和评测流程各不相同，难以判断模型是否真正具备跨语言推理、生成和自我评价能力。机器翻译分数也不能代表开放写作、跨语言摘要或语言学推理。WMT25 MIST 因此研究如何建立覆盖多种能力、30 种语言和统一提交协议的共享任务，并通过人工标注检验自动指标及 LLM-as-a-judge 在多语言条件下是否可靠。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: MIST releases nearly 20K multilingual prompts across 30 languages and five problem types: machine translation, linguistic reasoning, open-ended generation, cross-lingual summarization, and LLM-as-a-judge. The shared task has two rounds: the first collects system outputs for four generation tasks, and the second asks participating systems to evaluate outputs from other models. Official resources preserve raw submissions, automatic metrics, per-item human evaluations, and aggregated scores. Open-ended generation and summarization receive multidimensional seven-point Likert ratings, supporting both model benchmarking and evaluator meta-evaluation.

MIST 发布接近 20K 条多语言提示，覆盖机器翻译、语言学推理、开放生成、跨语言摘要和 LLM-as-a-judge 五类问题、30 种语言。共享任务分两轮：第一轮收集参赛模型在四个生成任务上的输出，第二轮让参赛系统评价其他模型输出。官方资源保留原始提交、自动指标、人类逐条评价和聚合分数，其中开放生成与摘要采用多维 Likert-7 人工评分，可用于模型 benchmark 和 evaluator 元评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Task design: Five capabilities—MT, linguistic reasoning, open-ended generation, cross-lingual summarization, and judging—are defined so multilingual ability is not represented by translation alone.
  2. Language and prompt construction: Nearly 20K blind-test prompts are prepared across 30 languages, including localized open questions and cross-lingual document inputs.
  3. First-round submission: Participating models generate translations, reasoning answers, open text, and summaries, and all raw outputs are retained.
  4. Second-round evaluation: Participating judges score MT, open-generation, and summarization outputs that lack unique answers.
  5. Human calibration: Per-item human evaluations and multidimensional seven-point Likert scores are collected and compared with automatic metrics and judge outputs, producing meta-evaluation data.

1. 任务设计：定义 MT、语言学推理、开放生成、跨语言摘要和 judge 五类能力，避免单一翻译任务代表全部多语言能力。
  2. 语言与提示构建：在 30 种语言中准备近 20K 条盲测提示，包含本地化开放问题和跨语言文档输入。
  3. 第一轮提交：参赛模型生成翻译、推理答案、开放文本和摘要，官方保存全部原始输出。
  4. 第二轮评价：参赛 judge 对无唯一答案的 MT、开放生成和摘要结果评分。
  5. 人工校准：收集逐项人工评价及 Likert-7 多维分数，与自动指标和 judge 结果比较，形成元评测数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The shared task evaluates a diverse set of open- and closed-weight models, preventing conclusions from depending on one system. Results show substantial ranking variation across subtasks and languages: strong translation does not guarantee strong linguistic reasoning or open-ended generation, and judge reliability changes across languages. Human annotations further reveal that automatic metrics may disagree with people on open-ended generation and cross-lingual summarization. Unified data and submission protocols improve comparability, although the number of participating systems, per-language sample sizes, and model versions limit long-term stability.
共享任务覆盖多种开源和闭源模型，使结果不依赖单一系统。报告显示，不同子任务和语言之间排名差异很大：翻译强并不保证语言学推理或开放生成强，部分 judge 对不同语言的评价可靠性也明显变化。人工标注进一步揭示，自动指标在开放生成和跨语言摘要上可能与人类偏好不一致。统一数据和提交协议增强了横向可比性，但参赛系统数量、语言样本量和当年模型版本仍限制结论的长期稳定性。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Traditional WMT tasks focus mainly on machine translation, while general multilingual benchmarks often use translated multiple-choice questions. MIST unifies structured linguistic reasoning, localized open-ended generation, multidocument cross-lingual summarization, and judge meta-evaluation in one shared task, releasing system outputs and human evaluations. Its most important novelty is the complete evaluation chain: it evaluates generators, evaluates judges that score those generators, and uses human ratings to audit the judges. It functions as standardized public experimental infrastructure rather than a paper proposing a single model.
传统 WMT 主要围绕机器翻译，通用多语言 benchmark 又常采用翻译后的选择题。MIST 将结构化语言学推理、本地化开放生成、多文档跨语言摘要和 judge 元评测纳入同一共享任务，并公开所有系统输出和人工评价。最重要的新意是评价链条完整：既测生成模型，也测评价这些生成结果的 judge，还用人工评分审查 judge。它更像标准化公共实验基础设施，而不是单篇论文提出的一个模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Coverage depth is uneven across 30 languages, and distributing nearly 20K prompts across multiple tasks may leave small language-task cells. Human ratings for open generation depend on culture, annotator composition, and Likert-scale calibration, so scores may not be directly comparable across languages. Public shared tasks are also vulnerable to future training contamination, and leaderboards age quickly as models change. The judge round evaluates existing system outputs and may not cover future error types. Reuse should maintain hidden tests, refresh prompts, and report language-specific confidence intervals.
30 种语言的覆盖深度并不均等，近 20K 提示分散到多任务后，每个语言—任务组合可能较小。开放生成的人类评分受文化、标注者和 Likert 尺度校准影响，跨语言分数不一定可直接比较。共享任务还容易随公开而被训练数据污染，模型版本更新后排行榜会快速过时。judge 轮次主要评价已有系统输出，不能完全覆盖未来错误类型。后续复用应保留隐藏测试、更新题库并按语言报告置信区间。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: MIST data can produce a multilingual capability matrix covering translation, reasoning, generation, summarization, and evaluation rather than one average score. Raw model outputs and human ratings are suitable for training multilingual reward models, calibrating LLM judges, or studying cross-lingual evaluation bias. The shared-task format can also organize internal model evaluations. For general judgment-data research, the most valuable components are open-ended generation, cross-lingual summarization, and their judge/human ratings; machine translation and deterministic linguistic problems are more conventional capability benchmarks.

MIST 数据可用于建立多语言模型的能力矩阵，分别分析翻译、推理、生成、摘要和评价，而不是只汇总一个平均分。原始模型输出与人类评分适合训练多语言 reward model、校准 LLM judge 或研究跨语言评价偏差。研究者还可复用共享任务格式组织内部模型评测。若只关注通用 judgment data，最有价值的是开放生成、跨语言摘要和对应 judge/human 评分；机器翻译和确定性语言学题则更偏能力 benchmark。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence positioning: It is a 30-language, nearly 20K-prompt shared task with multi-capability evaluation data.
  2. Task takeaway: It covers MT, linguistic reasoning, open-ended generation, cross-lingual summarization, and LLM-as-a-judge.
  3. Data takeaway: Resources include blind prompts, raw submissions, automatic scores, per-item human ratings, and aggregates.
  4. Key conclusion: Multilingual ability is highly task-dependent, and automatic metrics and judges are unstable across languages.
  5. Main risk: Per-language data is limited, human scales are difficult to align, and public benchmarks become contaminated and outdated.

1. 一句话定位：30 种语言、近 20K 提示的多能力共享任务与评价数据。
  2. 任务抓手：MT、语言学推理、开放生成、跨语言摘要和 LLM-as-a-judge。
  3. 数据抓手：盲测提示、原始提交、自动分数、逐条人工评价和聚合结果。
  4. 核心结论：多语言能力高度任务相关，自动评价和 judge 在不同语言上并不稳定。
  5. 主要风险：单语言样本有限、人工尺度难统一，公开 benchmark 会快速污染和过时。
